B-01.label: lax_and_strict
B-01.text: The vehicle shall leave the works trimmed to within +/-50 g of neutral buoyancy in the supplier's trim tank.

B-02.label: lax
B-02.text: The trim sheet shall state the mass in air and the net buoyancy in the trim tank, each read to 5 g or finer.

B-03.label: lax_and_strict
B-03.text: The vehicle shall be rated for a working depth of at least 100 m.

B-04.label: lax
B-04.text: Every pressure housing shall be proof-tested at not less than its rated pressure, held for at least 30 min.

B-05.label: keep
B-05.text: The depth sensor shall have a measuring range of at least 100 m.

B-06.label: lax
B-06.text: The battery pack shall be rated for a continuous discharge current of at least 40 A.

B-07.label: lax_and_strict
B-07.text: The vehicle shall develop a bollard thrust of at least 12.0 kgf along its longitudinal axis, measured astern.

B-08.label: lax
B-08.text: Maximum forward speed through the water shall be at least 1.5 m/s.

B-09.label: strict
B-09.text: The tether shall be at least 200 m long.

B-10.label: lax
B-10.text: The tether diameter shall not exceed 8.0 mm.

B-11.label: lax
B-11.text: The nominal energy of the battery pack shall be at least 250 Wh.

B-12.label: lax
B-12.text: The forward camera shall have a horizontal field of view of at least 80 deg in air.

B-13.label: strict
B-13.text: At least 4 lights shall be fitted.

B-14.label: lax
B-14.text: At 10 degC the battery pack shall deliver at least 80 % of its rated capacity.

B-15.label: keep
B-15.text: At least 6 thrusters shall be fitted.

B-16.label: keep
B-16.text: The scanning sonar shall have a minimum range of 1.0 m or less.

B-17.label: keep
B-17.text: Propellers shall be ducted, and the vehicle shall tolerate contact with fixed structures at 0.3 m/s without damage to thrusters, camera port or sensors.

B-18.label: keep
B-18.text: The vehicle shall operate in water between 0 degC and 30 degC.

B-19.label: keep
B-19.text: The DVL shall keep bottom lock down to an altitude of 0.5 m or less.

B-20.label: keep
B-20.text: The data link shall be proven over at least 250 m of tether.

B-21.label: keep
B-21.text: The gripper shall open to at least 40 mm.

B-22.label: keep
B-22.text: The vehicle ready to dive shall weigh no more than 20 kg in air.

B-23.label: keep
B-23.text: Static pitch as trimmed shall be within +/-5 deg.

B-24.label: keep
B-24.text: At least 1 complete set of spare seals for every pressure housing shall be supplied.

label_rule: lax <=> some configuration declares Comply and fails the row (m < -delta); strict <=> some accepted bid's cheapest OK configuration does not declare Comply (DESIGN 5.3)

provenance.note: text, need, row, comparator and threshold of every clause are the plan's; compliance and declared values recomputed on the frozen world (documents: factory-test-day state); declared values that follow the digest are references; label = the set rule at the frozen delta (recomputed by verify)
